// Gera o ícone do app (PNG em base64) durante o build, sem precisar de arquivo binário no repositório
val iconeB64 = ""
val iconeRes = layout.buildDirectory.dir("icone/res")
val gerarIcone by tasks.registering {
    val saida = iconeRes
    doLast {
        val dir = saida.get().asFile.resolve("mipmap-xxxhdpi")
        dir.mkdirs()
        dir.resolve("ic_launcher.png").writeBytes(java.util.Base64.getDecoder().decode(iconeB64))
    }
}
tasks.named("preBuild") { dependsOn(gerarIcone) }

##### FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/synapsea/Realce.kt
package com.example.synapsea

import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.text.AnnotatedString
import androidx.compose.ui.text.SpanStyle
import androidx.compose.ui.text.buildAnnotatedString
import androidx.compose.ui.text.input.OffsetMapping
import androidx.compose.ui.text.input.TransformedText
import androidx.compose.ui.text.input.VisualTransformation

object Realce {
    private val PALAVRAS = setOf(
        "and", "break", "do", "else", "elseif", "end", "false", "for", "function", "goto", "if", "in",
        "local", "nil", "not", "or", "repeat", "return", "then", "true", "until", "while", "continue"
    )

    private val BUILTINS = setOf(
        "game", "workspace", "script", "self", "print", "warn", "error", "pcall", "xpcall", "assert",
        "pairs", "ipairs", "next", "type", "typeof", "tostring", "tonumber", "select", "unpack",
        "require", "setmetatable", "getmetatable", "rawget", "rawset", "rawequal", "tick", "time",
        "wait", "spawn", "delay", "task", "math", "string", "table", "os", "coroutine", "utf8",
        "Instance", "Vector2", "Vector3", "CFrame", "Color3", "UDim", "UDim2", "Enum", "Random",
        "shared", "_G", "_VERSION", "loadstring", "getgenv", "getrenv", "getfenv", "setfenv"
    )

    private val C_PALAVRA = Color(0xFFF86D7C)
    private val C_BUILTIN = Color(0xFF84D6F7)
    private val C_FUNCAO = Color(0xFFFDFBAC)
    private val C_STRING = Color(0xFFADF195)
    private val C_NUMERO = Color(0xFFFFC600)
    private val C_COMENTARIO = Color(0xFF6A9955)

    private const val LIMITE_REALCE = 30000

    // Nível de um colchete longo ([[, [=[ ...) na posição p, ou null
    private fun nivel(s: String, p: Int): Int? {
        if (p >= s.length || s[p] != '[') return null
        var k = p + 1
        while (k < s.length && s[k] == '=') k++
        return if (k < s.length && s[k] == '[') k - p - 1 else null
    }

    fun realcar(src: String): AnnotatedString = buildAnnotatedString {
        append(src)
        if (src.length > LIMITE_REALCE) return@buildAnnotatedString

        val n = src.length
        var i = 0
        var anterior: Char? = null

        while (i < n) {
            val c = src[i]
            var cor: Color? = null
            val e: Int

            if (src.startsWith("--", i)) {
                cor = C_COMENTARIO
                val eq = nivel(src, i + 2)
                e = if (eq != null) {
                    val fecha = "]" + "=".repeat(eq) + "]"
                    val f = src.indexOf(fecha, i + 2)
                    if (f < 0) n - 1 else f + fecha.length - 1
                } else {
                    val nl = src.indexOf('\n', i)
                    (if (nl < 0) n else nl) - 1
                }
            } else if (c == '"' || c == '\'') {
                cor = C_STRING
                var j = i + 1
                while (j < n) {
                    val d = src[j]
                    if (d == '\\') j += 2
                    else if (d == c || d == '\n') break
                    else j++
                }
                var fim = minOf(j, n - 1)
                if (src[fim] == '\n') fim--
                e = fim
            } else if (c == '[' && nivel(src, i) != null) {
                cor = C_STRING
                val fecha = "]" + "=".repeat(nivel(src, i)!!) + "]"
                val f = src.indexOf(fecha, i)
                e = if (f < 0) n - 1 else f + fecha.length - 1
            } else if (c.isDigit() || (c == '.' && i + 1 < n && src[i + 1].isDigit())) {
                cor = C_NUMERO
                var j = i
                if (c == '0' && i + 1 < n && (src[i + 1] == 'x' || src[i + 1] == 'X')) {
                    j = i + 2
                    while (j < n && (src[j].isDigit() || src[j].lowercaseChar() in 'a'..'f')) j++
                } else {
                    while (j < n && src[j].isDigit()) j++
                    if (j < n && src[j] == '.') {
                        j++
                        while (j < n && src[j].isDigit()) j++
                    }
                    if (j < n && (src[j] == 'e' || src[j] == 'E')) {
                        var k = j + 1
                        if (k < n && (src[k] == '+' || src[k] == '-')) k++
                        if (k < n && src[k].isDigit()) {
                            while (k < n && src[k].isDigit()) k++
                            j = k
                        }
                    }
                }
                e = j - 1
            } else if (c.isLetter() || c == '_') {
                var j = i
                while (j < n && (src[j].isLetterOrDigit() || src[j] == '_')) j++
                val palavra = src.substring(i, j)
                e = j - 1
                cor = when {
                    palavra in PALAVRAS -> C_PALAVRA
                    palavra in BUILTINS && anterior != '.' -> C_BUILTIN
                    else -> {
                        var k = j
                        while (k < n && src[k].isWhitespace()) k++
                        if (k < n && src[k] == '(') C_FUNCAO else null
                    }
                }
            } else {
                e = i
            }

            if (cor != null) addStyle(SpanStyle(color = cor), i, e + 1)
            val trecho = src.substring(i, e + 1).trimEnd()
            if (trecho.isNotEmpty()) anterior = trecho.last()
            i = e + 1
        }
    }
}

val RealceTransform = VisualTransformation { texto ->
    TransformedText(Realce.realcar(texto.text), OffsetMapping.Identity)
}

##### FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/synapsea/MainActivity.kt
package com.example.synapsea

import android.Manifest
import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.graphics.Color
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.os.Process
import android.provider.Settings
import android.view.View
import android.webkit.JavascriptInterface
import android.webkit.WebResourceRequest
import android.webkit.WebView
import android.webkit.WebViewClient
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.activity.ComponentActivity
import androidx.activity.OnBackPressedCallback
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts
import androidx.compose.runtime.snapshotFlow
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import androidx.lifecycle.repeatOnLifecycle
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

// A tela é o HTML (assets/index.html) dentro de um WebView.
// Este arquivo só cuida de: permissão de notificação, permissão de sobreposição
// e de ligar/alternar/encerrar o OverlayService (o editor Lua continua em Kotlin).
class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() {

    private companion object {
        const val PAGINA = "file:///android_asset/index.html"
        const val FUNDO = "#0C0C0C"
    }

    private lateinit var web: WebView

    private val pedirOverlay =
        registerForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.StartActivityForResult()) { iniciar() }

    private val pedirNotificacao =
        registerForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission()) { pedirSobreposicao() }

    @SuppressLint("SetJavaScriptEnabled")
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)

        val fundo = Color.parseColor(FUNDO)
        window.statusBarColor = fundo
        window.navigationBarColor = fundo

        web = WebView(this).apply {
            setBackgroundColor(fundo)
            overScrollMode = View.OVER_SCROLL_NEVER
            settings.javaScriptEnabled = true
            settings.domStorageEnabled = true
            settings.allowContentAccess = false
            webViewClient = object : WebViewClient() {
                // Só páginas locais; qualquer link externo é bloqueado
                override fun shouldOverrideUrlLoading(v: WebView, r: WebResourceRequest): Boolean =
                    !r.url.toString().startsWith(PAGINA)

                override fun onPageFinished(v: WebView, url: String) = enviarEstado()
            }
            addJavascriptInterface(Ponte(), "SynapseNative")
            loadUrl(PAGINA)
        }
        setContentView(web)

        // Voltar navega entre as abas da página; na primeira, fecha a tela normalmente
        onBackPressedDispatcher.addCallback(this, object : OnBackPressedCallback(true) {
            override fun handleOnBackPressed() {
                if (web.canGoBack()) {
                    web.goBack()
                } else {
                    isEnabled = false
                    onBackPressedDispatcher.onBackPressed()
                }
            }
        })

        // Quando a janela flutuante liga/desliga/oculta, a página é avisada
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.STARTED) {
                snapshotFlow { Overlay.rodando to Overlay.oculto }.collect { enviarEstado() }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        enviarEstado()
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        web.removeJavascriptInterface("SynapseNative")
        web.destroy()
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    // Kotlin -> HTML
    private fun enviarEstado() {
        web.evaluateJavascript(
            "window.synapseEstado&&window.synapseEstado(${Overlay.rodando},${Overlay.oculto})",
            null
        )
    }

    // HTML -> Kotlin (os métodos rodam em outra thread, por isso o runOnUiThread)
    private inner class Ponte {
        @JavascriptInterface
        fun rodar() = runOnUiThread { this@MainActivity.rodar() }

        @JavascriptInterface
        fun alternar() = runOnUiThread { this@MainActivity.alternar() }

        @JavascriptInterface
        fun fecharTudo() = runOnUiThread { this@MainActivity.fecharTudo() }
    }

    private fun rodar() {
        if (Overlay.rodando) return
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33 &&
            ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS)
            != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        ) {
            pedirNotificacao.launch(Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS)
        } else {
            pedirSobreposicao()
        }
    }

    private fun pedirSobreposicao() {
        if (Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)) {
            iniciar()
        } else {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Ative \"Sobrepor a outros apps\" para o Synapse A", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            pedirOverlay.launch(
                Intent(Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_OVERLAY_PERMISSION, Uri.parse("package:$packageName"))
            )
        }
    }

    private fun iniciar() {
        if (Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)) {
            if (!Overlay.rodando) {
                ContextCompat.startForegroundService(this, Intent(this, OverlayService::class.java))
            }
        } else {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Permissão necessária para flutuar na tela", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }
    }

    private fun alternar() {
        if (!Overlay.rodando) return
        startService(Intent(this, OverlayService::class.java).setAction(OverlayService.ACAO_ALTERNAR))
    }

    private fun fecharTudo() {
        stopService(Intent(this, OverlayService::class.java))
        finishAndRemoveTask()
        // Garante que o processo todo termina, sem sobrar nada em segundo plano
        Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed({ Process.killProcess(Process.myPid()) }, 300)
    }
}

##### FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/synapsea/OverlayService.kt
package com.example.synapsea

import android.app.Notification
import android.app.NotificationChannel
import android.app.NotificationManager
import android.app.PendingIntent
import android.app.Service
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.ServiceInfo
import android.graphics.PixelFormat
import android.os.Build
import android.os.IBinder
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.ComposeView
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat
import androidx.core.app.ServiceCompat
import androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle
import androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleOwner
import androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleRegistry
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelStore
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelStoreOwner
import androidx.lifecycle.setViewTreeLifecycleOwner
import androidx.lifecycle.setViewTreeViewModelStoreOwner
import androidx.savedstate.SavedStateRegistry
import androidx.savedstate.SavedStateRegistryController
import androidx.savedstate.SavedStateRegistryOwner
import androidx.savedstate.setViewTreeSavedStateRegistryOwner
import java.io.File
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

// Estado observável: a tela inicial do app reage a ele
object Overlay {
    var rodando by mutableStateOf(false)
    var oculto by mutableStateOf(false)
}

// Dono de lifecycle falso: o Compose precisa disso para rodar dentro de um Service
class Dono : LifecycleOwner, SavedStateRegistryOwner, ViewModelStoreOwner {
    private val registro = LifecycleRegistry(this)
    private val controle = SavedStateRegistryController.create(this)
    override val lifecycle: Lifecycle get() = registro
    override val savedStateRegistry: SavedStateRegistry get() = controle.savedStateRegistry
    override val viewModelStore = ViewModelStore()

    fun criar() {
        controle.performAttach()
        controle.performRestore(null)
        registro.currentState = Lifecycle.State.RESUMED
    }

    fun destruir() {
        registro.currentState = Lifecycle.State.DESTROYED
        viewModelStore.clear()
    }
}

// Raiz que só "espia" o toque (coordenadas da tela) para mover a janela sem tremer
class Raiz(ctx: Context, private val aoToque: (MotionEvent) -> Unit) : FrameLayout(ctx) {
    override fun dispatchTouchEvent(ev: MotionEvent): Boolean {
        aoToque(ev)
        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev)
    }
}

class OverlayService : Service() {

    companion object {
        const val ACAO_PARAR = "parar"
        const val ACAO_ALTERNAR = "alternar"
        const val CANAL = "synapse_a"
    }

    private val dono = Dono()
    private lateinit var wm: WindowManager
    private lateinit var estado: Estado
    private var principal: Flutuante? = null
    private var janelaArquivos: Flutuante? = null

    private var d = 1f
    private var escala = 1f
    private var larguraTela = 0

    override fun onBind(intent: Intent?): IBinder? = null

    override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
        when (intent?.action) {
            ACAO_PARAR -> stopSelf()
            ACAO_ALTERNAR -> alternar()
        }
        return START_NOT_STICKY
    }

    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()
        Overlay.rodando = true
        Overlay.oculto = false
        dono.criar()
        iniciarNotificacao()

        wm = getSystemService(Context.WINDOW_SERVICE) as WindowManager
        val m = resources.displayMetrics
        d = m.density
        larguraTela = m.widthPixels
        // Em tela estreita (retrato) a janela inteira é reduzida para caber
        escala = min(1f, 0.96f * larguraTela / (560 * d))

        val pasta = File(filesDir, "SynapseA").apply { mkdirs() }
        estado = Estado(pasta)
        estado.onToggleArquivos = { if (janelaArquivos != null) fecharArquivos() else abrirArquivos() }
        estado.onFecharArquivos = { fecharArquivos() }

        val w = (560 * d * escala).roundToInt()
        val h = (245 * d * escala).roundToInt()
        val arrasto = Arrasto()
        try {
            principal = Flutuante(w, h, (larguraTela - w) / 2, (24 * d).roundToInt(), arrasto) {
                Escalado(escala) { Bloco(estado, arrasto) }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            stopSelf()
        }
    }

    private fun abrirArquivos() {
        val p = principal ?: return
        estado.arquivos = estado.pasta.list()?.sorted().orEmpty()
        val fw = (150 * d * escala).roundToInt()
        val fh = (230 * d * escala).roundToInt()
        val gap = (8 * d * escala).roundToInt()
        var x = p.posX + p.w + gap
        var y = p.posY
        if (x + fw > larguraTela) {
            x = p.posX - fw - gap
            if (x < 0) {
                x = p.posX
                y = p.posY + p.h + gap
            }
        }
        val arrasto = Arrasto()
        janelaArquivos = Flutuante(fw, fh, x, y, arrasto) {
            Escalado(escala) { JanelaArquivos(estado, arrasto) }
        }
    }

    // Mostra/oculta as janelas sem encerrar o serviço
    private fun alternar() {
        Overlay.oculto = !Overlay.oculto
        val ver = !Overlay.oculto
        principal?.visivel(ver)
        janelaArquivos?.visivel(ver)
    }

    private fun fecharArquivos() {
        janelaArquivos?.remover()
        janelaArquivos = null
    }

    private fun iniciarNotificacao() {
        val nm = getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java)
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
            nm.createNotificationChannel(
                NotificationChannel(CANAL, "Synapse A", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW)
            )
        }
        val parar = PendingIntent.getService(
            this, 0,
            Intent(this, OverlayService::class.java).setAction(ACAO_PARAR),
            PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE or PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
        )
        val notif: Notification = NotificationCompat.Builder(this, CANAL)
            .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_edit)
            .setContentTitle("Synapse A")
            .setContentText("Janela flutuante ativa")
            .setOngoing(true)
            .addAction(0, "Fechar", parar)
            .build()
        ServiceCompat.startForeground(this, 1, notif, ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MANIFEST)
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        janelaArquivos?.remover()
        principal?.remover()
        dono.destruir()
        Overlay.rodando = false
        Overlay.oculto = false
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    // Uma janela flutuante (WindowManager) com Compose dentro
    private inner class Flutuante(
        val w: Int, val h: Int, x: Int, y: Int,
        private val arrasto: Arrasto,
        conteudo: @Composable () -> Unit
    ) {
        private var fx = x.toFloat()
        private var fy = y.toFloat()
        private var ux = 0f
        private var uy = 0f
        private lateinit var raiz: Raiz

        val params = WindowManager.LayoutParams(
            w, h,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY,
            // Começa SEM foco: toques e teclado vão para o app de baixo.
            // Só ganha foco quando o editor é tocado (ver focavel).
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL or
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE or
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_WATCH_OUTSIDE_TOUCH,
            PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT
        ).apply {
            gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START
            this.x = x
            this.y = y
            softInputMode = WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_NOTHING
        }

        val posX: Int get() = params.x
        val posY: Int get() = params.y

        init {
            arrasto.aoFoco = { focavel(it) }
            raiz = Raiz(this@OverlayService) { ev ->
                when (ev.actionMasked) {
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_OUTSIDE -> focavel(false)
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                        ux = ev.rawX
                        uy = ev.rawY
                    }
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                        if (arrasto.ativo) {
                            fx += ev.rawX - ux
                            fy += ev.rawY - uy
                            params.x = fx.roundToInt()
                            params.y = fy.roundToInt()
                            wm.updateViewLayout(raiz, params)
                        }
                        ux = ev.rawX
                        uy = ev.rawY
                    }
                }
            }
            val cv = ComposeView(this@OverlayService).apply { setContent(conteudo) }
            listOf<View>(raiz, cv).forEach {
                it.setViewTreeLifecycleOwner(dono)
                it.setViewTreeSavedStateRegistryOwner(dono)
                it.setViewTreeViewModelStoreOwner(dono)
            }
            raiz.addView(cv)
            wm.addView(raiz, params)
        }

        // Janela com foco = teclado do editor funciona; sem foco = outros apps funcionam normal
        private fun focavel(f: Boolean) {
            val atual = params.flags
            val novo = if (f) atual and WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE.inv()
            else atual or WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE
            if (novo != atual) {
                params.flags = novo
                runCatching { wm.updateViewLayout(raiz, params) }
            }
        }

        fun visivel(v: Boolean) {
            if (!v) focavel(false)
            raiz.visibility = if (v) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        }

        fun remover() {
            runCatching { wm.removeView(raiz) }
        }
    }
}

// ===== Cores (iguais ao script Lua) =====
private val C12 = Color(0xFF0C0C0C)
private val C20 = Color(0xFF141414)
private val C25 = Color(0xFF191919)
private val C38 = Color(0xFF262626)
private val C40 = Color(0xFF282828)
private val C52 = Color(0xFF343434)
private val C70 = Color(0xFF464646)

private const val CONSOLE_COD =
    "game:GetService(\"StarterGui\"):SetCore(\"DevConsoleVisible\", true)"

class Aba(val nome: String, texto: String = "") {
    var texto by mutableStateOf(texto)
}

// Avisa o serviço que o usuário está arrastando a janela
class Arrasto {
    @Volatile
    var ativo = false

    // Liga/desliga o foco da janela (só ela precisa de foco para o teclado do editor)
    var aoFoco: (Boolean) -> Unit = {}
}

class Estado(val pasta: File) {
    val abas = mutableStateListOf(Aba("Script 1"))
    var ativa by mutableIntStateOf(0)
    private var contador = 1
    var anexado by mutableStateOf(false)
    var erro by mutableStateOf<String?>(null)
    var textoSave by mutableStateOf("Save File")
    val log = mutableStateListOf<String>()
    var arquivos by mutableStateOf(listOf<String>())

    var onToggleArquivos: () -> Unit = {}
    var onFecharArquivos: () -> Unit = {}

    fun mostrarErro(m: String) {
        erro = if (m.length > 110) m.take(107) + "..." else m
    }

    fun novaAba(texto: String = "", nome: String? = null) {
        contador++
        abas.add(Aba(nome ?: "Script $contador", texto))
        ativa = abas.lastIndex
    }

    fun fecharAba(i: Int) {
        if (abas.size == 1) {
            abas[0].texto = ""
            return
        }
        abas.removeAt(i)
        if (i < ativa) ativa-- else if (i == ativa) ativa = minOf(i, abas.lastIndex)
    }

    fun exige(acao: () -> Unit): () -> Unit = {
        if (!anexado) mostrarErro("Clique em Attach primeiro para usar esta função.") else acao()
    }

    fun executar(codigo: String) {
        if (codigo.isEmpty()) return
        val g = JsePlatform.standardGlobals()
        val saida = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        g.STDOUT = PrintStream(saida, true)
        val fn = try {
            g.load(codigo, "script")
        } catch (e: LuaError) {
            mostrarErro("Erro de sintaxe: ${e.message}")
            return
        }
        Thread {
            var falha: String? = null
            try {
                fn.call()
            } catch (e: Throwable) {
                falha = "[Synapse A] erro: ${e.message}"
            }
            saida.toString().trimEnd().lines().filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.forEach { log.add(it) }
            falha?.let { log.add(it) }
            while (log.size > 50) log.removeAt(0)
        }.start()
    }

    fun salvarAtiva(): Boolean {
        val a = abas[ativa]
        var nome = a.nome.replace(Regex("[^\\w\\- .]"), "_")
        val baixo = nome.lowercase()
        if (!baixo.endsWith(".lua") && !baixo.endsWith(".txt")) nome += ".lua"
        return runCatching { File(pasta, nome).writeText(a.texto) }.isSuccess
    }

    fun abrirArquivo(nome: String) {
        val conteudo = runCatching { File(pasta, nome).readText() }.getOrNull()
        if (conteudo != null) novaAba(conteudo, nome)
    }
}

private fun Modifier.vGrad(a: Color, b: Color) =
    background(Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(a, b)))

private fun Modifier.borda() = border(1.dp, C70)

private fun Modifier.arrastar(a: Arrasto) =
    pointerInput(Unit) {
        detectDragGestures(
            onDragStart = { a.ativo = true },
            onDragEnd = { a.ativo = false },
            onDragCancel = { a.ativo = false }
        ) { change, _ -> change.consume() }
    }

// Escala toda a UI (dp e sp) para caber em telas estreitas
@Composable
fun Escalado(escala: Float, conteudo: @Composable () -> Unit) {
    val base = LocalDensity.current
    CompositionLocalProvider(
        LocalDensity provides Density(base.density * escala, base.fontScale),
        content = conteudo
    )
}

@Composable
fun Bloco(est: Estado, arrasto: Arrasto) {
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val clip = LocalClipboardManager.current
    val ativa = est.ativa

    Box(Modifier.size(560.dp, 245.dp).background(C40).arrastar(arrasto)) {
        // Top bar + linha + título + logo
        Box(Modifier.size(560.dp, 32.dp).vGrad(C40, C12))
        Box(Modifier.offset(y = 32.dp).size(560.dp, 1.dp).background(C70))
        Box(Modifier.size(560.dp, 32.dp), Alignment.Center) {
            Text("synapse A - 1.0.0", color = Color.White, fontSize = 14.sp)
        }
        Box(Modifier.offset(5.dp, 3.dp).size(26.dp), Alignment.Center) {
            val ic = iconeBitmap
            if (ic != null) {
                Image(ic, "Synapse A", Modifier.size(26.dp))
            } else {
                Text(
                    "S", color = Color.White, fontSize = 22.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontStyle = FontStyle.Italic
                )
            }
        }

        // Abas
        Row(
            Modifier
                .offset(10.dp, 38.dp)
                .size(390.dp, 20.dp)
                .horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(1.dp)
        ) {
            est.abas.forEachIndexed { i, a ->
                val on = i == ativa
                Row(
                    Modifier
                        .fillMaxHeight()
                        .background(if (on) Color(0xFF1E1E1E) else Color(0xFF101010))
                        .padding(start = 5.dp, end = 4.dp),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {
                    Text(
                        a.nome, fontSize = 13.sp, maxLines = 1,
                        color = if (on) Color.White else Color(0xFF969696),
                        modifier = Modifier.clickable { est.ativa = i }
                    )
                    Spacer(Modifier.width(3.dp))
                    Text(
                        "×", fontSize = 15.sp, color = Color(0xFFAAAAAA),
                        modifier = Modifier.clickable { est.fecharAba(i) }
                    )
                }
            }
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .fillMaxHeight()
                    .width(20.dp)
                    .background(Color(0xFF101010))
                    .clickable { est.novaAba() },
                Alignment.Center
            ) { Text("+", fontSize = 16.sp, color = Color(0xFFC8C8C8)) }
        }

        // Editor com realce de sintaxe
        key(est.abas[ativa]) {
            Editor(est.abas[ativa], Modifier.offset(10.dp, 60.dp).size(390.dp, 140.dp), arrasto)
        }

        // Caixa lateral: console >
        Box(Modifier.offset(412.dp, 38.dp).size(138.dp, 162.dp).vGrad(C25, C38).borda()) {
            Row(
                Modifier
                    .offset(6.dp, 4.dp)
                    .height(20.dp)
                    .clickable { est.novaAba(CONSOLE_COD, "console") },
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Text("console", color = Color.White, fontSize = 14.sp)
                Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                Text("›", color = Color(0xFF828282), fontSize = 18.sp)
            }
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .offset(6.dp, 28.dp)
                    .size(126.dp, 130.dp)
                    .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
            ) {
                Text(
                    est.log.joinToString("\n"), color = Color(0xFF9A9A9A),
                    fontSize = 9.sp, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace
                )
            }
        }

        // Botões
        Botao("Execute", 4, 68, est.exige { est.executar(est.abas[est.ativa].texto) })
        Botao("Clear", 76, 68) { est.abas[est.ativa].texto = "" }
        Botao("Execute Clip", 148, 92, est.exige {
            val t = clip.getText()?.text.orEmpty()
            if (t.isNotEmpty()) est.executar(t)
        })
        Botao("Open File", 244, 68, est.exige { est.onToggleArquivos() })
        Botao(est.textoSave, 316, 68, est.exige {
            est.textoSave = if (est.salvarAtiva()) "Saved!" else "Error"
            scope.launch {
                delay(1000)
                est.textoSave = "Save File"
            }
        })
        Botao(if (est.anexado) "Attached" else "Attach", 482, 68) {
            if (!est.anexado) {
                est.anexado = true
                est.erro = null
            }
        }

        // Popup de erro
        est.erro?.let { msg ->
            Popup(msg, { est.erro = null }, Modifier.align(Alignment.Center))
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun Editor(aba: Aba, modifier: Modifier, arrasto: Arrasto) {
    Box(
        modifier
            .vGrad(C25, C38)
            .borda()
            // Tocou no editor: a janela passa a aceitar foco (teclado). Não consome o toque.
            .pointerInput(Unit) {
                awaitEachGesture {
                    awaitFirstDown(requireUnconsumed = false, pass = PointerEventPass.Initial)
                    arrasto.aoFoco(true)
                }
            }
    ) {
        BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            val w = maxWidth
            val h = maxHeight
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
                    .horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState())
            ) {
                BasicTextField(
                    value = aba.texto,
                    onValueChange = { if (it.length <= 200000) aba.texto = it },
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .sizeIn(minWidth = w, minHeight = h)
                        .padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
                        .onFocusChanged { if (!it.isFocused) arrasto.aoFoco(false) },
                    textStyle = TextStyle(
                        color = Color.White,
                        fontSize = 10.sp,
                        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace
                    ),
                    cursorBrush = SolidColor(Color.White),
                    visualTransformation = RealceTransform
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun Botao(texto: String, x: Int, largura: Int, onClick: () -> Unit) {
    val src = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }
    val press by src.collectIsPressedAsState()
    Box(
        Modifier
            .offset(x.dp, 212.dp)
            .size(largura.dp, 24.dp)
            .vGrad(if (press) C38 else C52, if (press) C12 else C20)
            .clickable(interactionSource = src, indication = null, onClick = onClick),
        Alignment.Center
    ) {
        Text(texto, color = Color.White, fontSize = 14.sp, maxLines = 1)
    }
}

@Composable
fun Popup(msg: String, onFechar: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier) {
    Box(modifier.size(250.dp, 92.dp).vGrad(C25, C38).borda()) {
        Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(24.dp).vGrad(C40, C12)) {
            Text(
                "Synapse A", color = Color.White, fontSize = 13.sp,
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.Center)
            )
            Text(
                "×", color = Color(0xFFC8C8C8), fontSize = 20.sp, textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
                modifier = Modifier
                    .align(Alignment.CenterEnd)
                    .width(24.dp)
                    .clickable { onFechar() }
            )
        }
        Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(1.dp).offset(y = 24.dp).background(C70))
        Text(
            msg, color = Color.White, fontSize = 14.sp, textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
            modifier = Modifier
                .align(Alignment.Center)
                .padding(top = 24.dp, start = 10.dp, end = 10.dp)
        )
    }
}

@Composable
fun JanelaArquivos(est: Estado, arrasto: Arrasto) {
    Box(Modifier.size(150.dp, 230.dp).background(C40)) {
        Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(26.dp).vGrad(C40, C12).arrastar(arrasto)) {
            Text(
                "Open File", color = Color.White, fontSize = 13.sp,
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.Center)
            )
            Text(
                "×", color = Color(0xFFC8C8C8), fontSize = 20.sp, textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
                modifier = Modifier
                    .align(Alignment.CenterEnd)
                    .width(26.dp)
                    .clickable { est.onFecharArquivos() }
            )
        }
        Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(1.dp).offset(y = 26.dp).background(C70))
        Box(Modifier.offset(6.dp, 32.dp).size(138.dp, 192.dp).vGrad(C25, C38).borda()) {
            Column(
                Modifier
                    .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
                    .padding(start = 6.dp, top = 4.dp)
            ) {
                if (est.arquivos.isEmpty()) {
                    Text("(sem arquivos)", color = Color(0xFF787878), fontSize = 13.sp)
                } else {
                    est.arquivos.forEach { nome ->
                        Text(
                            nome, color = Color.White, fontSize = 13.sp, maxLines = 1,
                            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .fillMaxWidth()
                                .height(20.dp)
                                .clickable { est.abrirArquivo(nome) }
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.synapsea

import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.util.Base64
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.ImageBitmap
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.asImageBitmap

// Ícone do Synapse A (PNG 96x96) embutido em base64
private const val ICONE_B64 = ""

val iconeBitmap: ImageBitmap? by lazy {
    runCatching {
        val bytes = Base64.decode(ICONE_B64, Base64.DEFAULT)
        BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(bytes, 0, bytes.size).asImageBitmap()
    }.getOrNull()
}

<script>
/* Para adicionar uma página: inclua uma entrada em PAGES e um link. */
/* Ponte com o app Android (MainActivity.kt). Fora do app, NAT é null e a aba Launch simula. */
const NAT=window.SynapseNative||null;if(NAT)document.documentElement.classList.add('app');
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s),rm=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches;
const PAGES={download:'Download',docs:'Documentation',changelog:'Changelog',community:'Community'};
const SECS=['features','interface','roadmap'];

/* ícone: o Kotlin envia o PNG real (ver MainActivity.onPageFinished); sem isso fica o "S" */
let ICON='data:image/png;base64,';
function setIcon(){if(!ICON)return;document.querySelectorAll('.lg').forEach(e=>{e.innerHTML='<img alt="" src="'+ICON+'">'})}
window.synapseIcone=s=>{ICON=s;setIcon()};
setIcon();
let fv=document.createElement('link');fv.rel='icon';fv.href=ICON;document.head.appendChild(fv);

/* conteúdo */
const FEATS=[
['Realce de sintaxe','Palavras-chave, funções, strings, números e comentários em cores próprias.'],
['Abas','Vários scripts abertos ao mesmo tempo. O × fecha, o + cria um novo.'],
['Console','A saída do script aparece na caixa lateral, com as últimas 50 linhas.'],
['Arquivos','Salve e reabra scripts .lua e .txt pela janela Open File.'],
['Janela flutuante','Arraste pela barra de título. Oculte sem encerrar.'],
['Teclado sob demanda','Só aparece quando você toca no editor. Fora dele, o app de baixo funciona normal.']];
$('#fr').innerHTML=FEATS.map((f,i)=>`<div class="r"><span class="nm">${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')}</span><h3>${f[0]}</h3><p>${f[1]}</p></div>`).join('');
const ANAT=[
['Barra de título','560 × 32','Arraste para mover a janela.'],
['Abas','rolagem horizontal','+ cria, × fecha.'],
['Editor','390 × 140','Aceita até 200 mil caracteres.'],
['Console','138 × 162','Toque em console para abrir o console do jogo.'],
['Botões','6 ações','Execute, Clear, Execute Clip, Open File, Save File e Attach.']];
$('#ar').innerHTML=ANAT.map(f=>`<div class="r t"><h3>${f[0]}</h3><span class="chip">${f[1]}</span><p>${f[2]}</p></div>`).join('');

/* realce (mesmas cores e regras do Realce.kt, em versão curta) */
const KW=new Set('and break do else elseif end false for function goto if in local nil not or repeat return then true until while continue'.split(' '));
const BI=new Set('game workspace script self print warn error pcall type typeof tostring tonumber select unpack require math string table os task wait spawn Instance Vector3 CFrame Color3 Enum'.split(' '));
const E=s=>s.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
function hl(s){return s.replace(/(--[^\n]*)|("(?:[^"\\\n]|\\.)*"?|'(?:[^'\\\n]|\\.)*'?)|(\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?\b)|([A-Za-z_]\w*)([ \t]*\()?|([&<>])/g,(m,c,st,n,w,p,o)=>{
if(c)return`<i class=c>${E(c)}</i>`;if(st)return`<i class=s>${E(st)}</i>`;if(n)return`<i class=n>${n}</i>`;if(o)return E(o);
const q=p?E(p):'';if(KW.has(w))return`<i class=k>${w}</i>${q}`;if(BI.has(w))return`<i class=b>${w}</i>${q}`;if(p)return`<i class=f>${w}</i>${q}`;return w})}

/* janela do editor, na mesma geometria do Ui.kt */
const BTN=[['Execute',4,68],['Clear',76,68],['Execute Clip',148,92],['Open File',244,68],['Save File',316,68],['Attach',482,68]];
const win=()=>`<div class="w"><div class="tb">synapse A - 1.1.0</div><span class="lg"><b>S</b></span><div class="tabs"><b class="on">Script 1<u>×</u></b><b class="pl">+</b></div><div class="ed"><pre></pre></div><div class="cn"><div class="ch">console<em>›</em></div><pre class="out"></pre></div>${BTN.map(b=>`<button class="bn" tabindex="-1" style="left:${b[1]}px;width:${b[2]}px">${b[0]}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
document.querySelectorAll('.wbox').forEach(b=>b.innerHTML=win());
function fit(){document.querySelectorAll('.wbox').forEach(b=>{const w=b.firstElementChild;if(b.clientWidth)w.style.transform='scale('+b.clientWidth/560+')'})}
addEventListener('resize',fit);

const SRC='-- olá, synapse\nlocal nome = "Synapse A"\nfor i = 1, 3 do\n  print(nome, i)\nend';
const OUT=['Synapse A\t1','Synapse A\t2','Synapse A\t3'];
const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));
function parts(w){const bn=w.querySelectorAll('.bn');return{ed:w.querySelector('.ed pre'),out:w.querySelector('.out'),ex:bn[0],cl:bn[1],sv:bn[4],at:bn[5]}}
function still(box){const p=parts(box);p.ed.innerHTML=hl(SRC);p.out.textContent=OUT.join('\n');p.at.textContent='Attached'}
async function demo(box){const p=parts(box);
const draw=t=>p.ed.innerHTML=hl(t)+'<i class="cur"></i>';
const press=async b=>{b.classList.add('p');await sleep(160);b.classList.remove('p')};
if(rm){still(box);return}
for(;;){draw('');p.out.textContent='';p.at.textContent='Attach';await sleep(1300);
for(let i=1;i<=SRC.length;i++){draw(SRC.slice(0,i));await sleep(SRC[i-1]==='\n'?280:26+Math.random()*40)}
await sleep(500);await press(p.at);p.at.textContent='Attached';await sleep(400);await press(p.ex);
for(const l of OUT){p.out.textContent+=(p.out.textContent?'\n':'')+l;await sleep(280)}
await sleep(2200);await press(p.sv);p.sv.textContent='Saved!';await sleep(1000);p.sv.textContent='Save File';await sleep(1400);await press(p.cl)}}
still($('#lv-w'));demo($('#hero-w'));

/* rotas por hash */
function route(){const h=location.hash.slice(1)||(NAT?'launch':'home');
let id='v-home';if(h==='launch')id='v-launch';else if(PAGES[h]){id='v-cs';$('#cs-n').textContent=PAGES[h]}
document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v=>v.classList.toggle('on',v.id===id));
document.querySelectorAll('.links a').forEach(a=>a.classList.toggle('on',a.getAttribute('href')==='#'+h));
lk.classList.remove('o');bg.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');fit();
SECS.includes(h)?document.getElementById(h).scrollIntoView():scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'})}
addEventListener('hashchange',route);
bg.onclick=()=>{const o=lk.classList.toggle('o');bg.setAttribute('aria-expanded',o)};
if(!rm)addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{const r=document.documentElement.style;r.setProperty('--mx',e.clientX+'px');r.setProperty('--my',e.clientY+'px')},{passive:true});

/* Launch: controles do app (rodar, mostrar/ocultar, fechar) */
const L={run:false,show:true};
function lc(){const r=L.run;ls.classList.toggle('on',r);lt.textContent=r?'Janela ativa':'Janela desligada';
lr.disabled=r;lr.textContent=r?'Rodando':'Rodar';lw.disabled=!r;lw.setAttribute('aria-checked',String(r&&L.show));
fw.classList.toggle('on',r&&L.show);
lh.textContent=!r?'Toque em Rodar para abrir a janela.':L.show?'Janela visível sobre o app.':'Janela oculta, ainda em execução.'}
/* O Kotlin chama synapseEstado(rodando, oculto) sempre que o estado da janela muda */
window.synapseEstado=(r,o)=>{L.run=!!r;L.show=!o;lc()};
lr.onclick=()=>{if(NAT){NAT.rodar()}else{L.run=true;L.show=true;lc()}};
lw.onclick=()=>{if(!L.run)return;if(NAT){NAT.alternar()}else{L.show=!L.show;lc()}};
lx.onclick=()=>{if(NAT){NAT.fecharTudo()}else{L.run=false;L.show=true;lc()}};

/* revelar ao rolar */
(function(){const els=document.querySelectorAll('.eb,h2,.sub,.pal,.r,.stats div,.cs .big,.cs h1');
els.forEach((e,i)=>{if(e.closest('.hero')&&!e.closest('.stats'))return;e.classList.add('rv');e.style.transitionDelay=(i%3)*90+'ms'});
if(!('IntersectionObserver' in window)){els.forEach(e=>e.classList.add('in'));return}
const o=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');o.unobserve(e.target)}}),{threshold:.12});
document.querySelectorAll('.rv').forEach(e=>o.observe(e))})();
lc();route();
/* revelar ao rolar: cada elemento aparece uma única vez */
{const els=document.querySelectorAll('.sec .eb,.sec h2,.sec .sub,.sec .pal,.rows>.r,#v-launch .eb,#v-launch h2,#v-launch .sub,.pn,.scr,.note,.back,footer .fg>*');
if(rm||!('IntersectionObserver' in window))els.forEach(e=>e.classList.add('in'));
else{const io2=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io2.unobserve(e.target)}}),{rootMargin:'0px 0px -8% 0px',threshold:.05});
const cnt=new Map();els.forEach(e=>{const p=e.parentElement,k=cnt.get(p)||0;cnt.set(p,k+1);if(p.classList.contains('rows')||p.classList.contains('fg'))e.style.setProperty('--d',(k%3)*.09+'s');e.classList.add('rv');io2.observe(e)})}}
if('IntersectionObserver' in window){const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>{if(!$('#v-home').classList.contains('on'))return;es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)document.querySelectorAll('.links a').forEach(a=>a.classList.toggle('on',a.getAttribute('href')==='#'+e.target.id))})},{rootMargin:'-45% 0px -50% 0px'});SECS.concat('home').forEach(id=>{const el=document.getElementById(id);el&&io.observe(el)})}
</script>
